name: corkathon
description: Whoop -> AI gateway -> Hospital FHIR pipeline (hackathon scaffold).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix whoop install && npm --prefix gateway install && npm --prefix hospital install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n whoop,gateway,hospital,admin -c blue,magenta,green,cyan "npm run start:whoop" "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:hospital" "npm run start:admin"
